name: com.affitor/mcp
title: Affitor
description: Affiliate programs in AI tools: read partners, commissions and payouts; track clicks and sales.

environmentVariables.name: AFFITOR_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your Affitor program API key. Server-side only.

environmentVariables.name: AFFITOR_AGENT_KEY
environmentVariables.description: An Affitor agent key with the coupons:write scope, for the coupon tools. Used only by the coupon tools. Server-side only.

environmentVariables.name: AFFITOR_MCP_COUPONS
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to add the coupon tools (create, lock, get). Needs AFFITOR_AGENT_KEY. Off by default.

environmentVariables.name: AFFITOR_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: API base override. Defaults to https://api.affitor.com.

environmentVariables.name: AFFITOR_MCP_WRITE
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to register the two tools that move money (track sale, track refund). Off by default.
